title: TileMerge
summary: A 2048-style sliding tile puzzle that runs in the browser.

manual: Open the URL in a browser.
Use arrow keys/WASD to slide tiles or swipe on touchscreen.
Confirm matching tiles merge into their sum and a new tile spawns.
Test custom themes by clicking 'Theme' in the header, customising, and loading.
Confirm score updates, undo rewinds moves, and best score persists on reload.

notes: Pure static files; zero compilation or npm dependencies needed. Completely offline capable.
